description:
NinjaTrader 8 is open on the Windows desktop with a daily chart of SPY (S&P 500 ETF) showing real price data from January 2023 to December 2024 (502 trading days of OHLCV data from Yahoo Finance).

Your task:
1. Right-click on the chart and select 'Indicators...' (or use the Indicators button in the toolbar).
2. In the Indicators dialog, find and add a 'SMA' (Simple Moving Average) indicator.
3. Set the Period parameter to 20.
4. Click OK to apply the indicator.
5. The 20-period SMA should now be visible as a line overlaid on the SPY price chart.
